page.overview:
Who is Spike?

Spike is a Purple Dragon member with red spiky hair. He appears as a regular enemy in the 2003 GBA video game wielding a crowbar. He also appears as a non-playable opponent in Mutant Melee wielding a pipe. He also has a yellowed-haired doppelganger in Mutant Melee. He was voiced by Eric Stuart.
